items.reversibility_note_zh: 在所有已记录的人体病例中,一旦换用含n-3的脂质来源,神经系统症状即消失,皮肤病变也随之消退,血浆脂肪酸谱同步恢复正常,未见有残留缺陷的报告。需要坦率说明的是,所有报告病例都是在数月内被发现的,人体经历更长期缺乏后会有何后果,目前尚不清楚。
items.at_risk_zh: 长期接受肠外营养或管饲、且脂质来源n-3含量偏低的患者,历史上多见于以红花油为基础的乳剂。正常进食普通食物的人基本不会面临这一风险,因为ALA广泛存在于植物油、坚果、种子和绿叶蔬菜中。长年维持极低脂饮食是一种理论上的风险,目前没有相应的病例系列支持。
items.prevalence_zh: 无确切数据。临床ALA缺乏症仅见于个案报告以及肠外营养和管饲患者的小型病例系列。由于该病不会出现在正常进食的自由生活人群中,因此不存在人群患病率数据。

items.function_short_zh: 来自海洋微藻的油脂,可提供现成的DHA,部分产品还含有EPA,无需依赖鱼类。
items.function_full_zh: 藻油提取自养殖的异养微藻,主要是Schizochytrium属和Crypthecodinium cohnii。这些正是海洋食物链底端真正合成DHA的生物,鱼类是通过摄食它们才积累了DHA。Crypthecodinium来源的产品只提供DHA,而Schizochytrium来源的产品则同时提供DHA和少量EPA。就生理作用而言,藻油本身并不具备DHA和EPA以外的额外作用,其机制详见Omega-3(EPA and DHA)词条。对照喂养研究发现,就血浆掺入而言,藻油胶囊与熟三文鱼是营养等效的DHA来源(PMID 18589030),这也是数十年来藻源DHA一直是婴儿配方奶粉标准来源的原因。
items.deficiency_early_zh: 不适用。藻油是一种人工制造的递送形式,而非营养素本身,不存在对藻油本身的缺乏。真正重要的是DHA和EPA的营养状态问题,已在Omega-3(EPA and DHA)词条中回答。
items.at_risk_zh: 作为缺乏症而言不适用。但从实际供给角度看,对不吃鱼的人来说,藻油是唯一能直接提供现成DHA的膳食来源,因为ALA转化生成DHA在女性中量很少,在男性中则检测不到。

items.function_short_zh: 来自南极磷虾的油脂,所含EPA和DHA大部分以磷脂形式结合,还含有少量虾青素。
items.function_full_zh: 磷虾油提取自Euphausia superba。其区别性特征在于化学形式:其中很大一部分EPA和DHA以磷脂形式酯化,主要是磷脂酰胆碱,还有一部分以游离脂肪酸形式存在,而鱼油中的EPA和DHA则以甘油三酯或乙酯形式存在。这会改变吸收动力学。磷虾油还含有少量虾青素,这是一种在油中发挥抗氧化作用的类胡萝卜素。每粒胶囊所含的EPA加DHA总量通常低于鱼油,因此剂量比较需要按每毫克omega-3来计算。急性交叉试验发现,按每单位EPA加DHA计算,磷虾油的血浆磷脂掺入率与鱼油相当或略高(PMID 21854650),但对这些研究的再分析认为,这种急性差异并未可靠地转化为长期omega-3状态的差异(PMID 25156381)。
items.deficiency_early_zh: 不适用。磷虾油是一类人工制造的产品,而非必需营养素,不存在针对它的缺乏状态。真正相关的生理指标是EPA和DHA的营养状态,已在Omega-3(EPA and DHA)词条中说明。

items.function_short_zh: 浓缩的食物蛋白,提供用于构建和修复肌肉及全身各组织的氨基酸。
items.function_full_zh: 蛋白粉是分离出的食物蛋白(乳清、酪蛋白、大豆、豌豆、大米、鸡蛋来源),经干燥浓缩而成。它本身并无独立的功能,其作用等同于膳食蛋白质:提供九种必需氨基酸,并提供合成肌肉、酶、白蛋白、免疫球蛋白、血红蛋白、激素和结缔组织所需的氮。成年人每天大约有250到300 g体内蛋白质发生更新,其中大部分被循环利用,膳食摄入主要用于补偿必然发生的氧化损耗。美国的RDA为0.8 g/kg/day。PROT-AGE小组建议健康老年人摄入1.0到1.2 g/kg/day,在急性或慢性疾病期间摄入1.2到1.5 g/kg/day,因为随着年龄增长,肌肉对给定蛋白剂量的合成反应会减弱(PMID 23867520)。
items.deficiency_name_zh: 公认的蛋白缺乏状态是消瘦型营养不良(marasmus)和蛋白质能量营养不良。夸希奥科病(kwashiorkor)过去被描述为重度急性营养不良的另一极端,但目前的认识是,它是重度营养不良的一种多因素并发症,病因尚不明确,不能直接归因于蛋白质缺乏。介于二者之间的临床类型称为marasmic kwashiorkor。肌少症(sarcopenia)是一种与年龄相关的肌肉疾病,本身并非缺乏状态,蛋白摄入不足只是其诸多可调节诱因之一。
items.deficiency_early_zh: 非自主体重下降、上臂中段周径缩小、皮下脂肪和肌肉量减少、头发变细变脆、伤口愈合延迟以及感染更为频繁。血清白蛋白下降出现较晚,且受炎症的干扰很大,因此不是一个理想的早期指标。在老年人中,握力下降和步速减慢通常先于肉眼可见的肌肉丢失出现。
items.deficiency_severe_zh: 消瘦型营养不良(marasmus)表现为严重消瘦:身高别体重远低于正常水平,肌肉和脂肪明显减少,幼儿呈现出苍老的外貌。夸希奥科病(kwashiorkor)在此基础上还会出现凹陷性水肿、脂肪肝肿大、皮肤呈剥落漆片样脱屑,以及毛发脱色。两者的病死率都很高,主要死因包括低血糖、体温过低、电解质紊乱和严重感染,若不进行规范的再喂养,最终结局是死亡。在老年人中,未经治疗的肌少症(sarcopenia)最终会导致跌倒、骨折、丧失自理能力和死亡率升高。
items.reversibility_note_zh: 急性消瘦可通过谨慎的分阶段再喂养逆转,身高别体重能够恢复。无法完全恢复的是线性生长和神经认知发育,如果发作发生在生命最初1000天内:两岁前已形成的发育迟缓大体上是永久性的,相关的认知缺陷会持续到成年。肌少症(sarcopenia)属于部分可逆:配合充足蛋白摄入的抗阻训练可以重建部分力量和肌量,但数十年间流失的肌肉无法完全恢复。
items.at_risk_zh: 生活在食物无保障环境中的儿童,尤其是在断奶前后和感染之后。住院患者、术后患者和危重症患者。食欲不佳、有牙齿问题、吞咽困难或社交孤立的老年人。患有吸收不良、肝硬化,或因癌症、晚期肾衰竭或心力衰竭而出现恶病质的人。神经性厌食症患者。在富裕国家摄入足够热量的健康成年人几乎不会出现蛋白质摄入不足。
items.prevalence_zh: 2024年,5岁以下儿童中有4280万人消瘦(6.6%),1220万人重度消瘦(1.9%),另有1.502亿人发育迟缓(数据来自UNICEF/WHO/World Bank Joint Malnutrition Estimates,2025年版)。老年人肌少症患病率,按EWGSOP1标准为17.7%,按EWGSOP2标准为11%。

items.function_short_zh: 一种人体可自行合成的氨基酸,是肠道黏膜和免疫细胞偏好的燃料来源。
items.function_full_zh: 谷氨酰胺是血浆和骨骼肌中含量最丰富的游离氨基酸。肌肉通过glutamine synthetase持续合成并向外输出谷氨酰胺,因此供应量通常由内源性生成决定,而非由膳食决定。肠上皮细胞和快速分裂的免疫细胞将其作为优选的呼吸燃料,并作为嘌呤、嘧啶和谷胱甘肽合成所需的氮供体,这正是肠道修复说法背后的生化基础。健康状态下它被归为非必需氨基酸,而在严重分解代谢状态下则属于条件必需氨基酸,此时肌肉的输出速度跟不上消耗速度。关于口服谷氨酰胺用于肠道通透性、IBS和炎症性肠病的人体试验规模小且结果不一致,现有最强的证据集中在特定临床情境下,尚未在健康人群中得到证实。
items.deficiency_early_zh: 不适用。谷氨酰胺没有膳食需求量,因此也就不存在可检测的膳食性缺乏。血浆谷氨酰胺水平降低是危重症、重大创伤或烧伤的后果,与饮食内容无关。
items.deficiency_severe_zh: ICU患者血浆谷氨酰胺低于约420 micromol/L与更高的死亡率相关,但这反映的是分解代谢的严重程度,而非营养素本身的短缺。把它当作需要纠正的缺乏来治疗,结果证明是有害的:在纳入1223名接受机械通气、伴多器官衰竭的ICU患者的REDOXS试验中,大剂量谷氨酰胺反而提高了住院期间和六个月的死亡率(PMID 23594003)。
items.at_risk_zh: 不适用。没有人会因为饮食而出现谷氨酰胺缺乏。血浆浓度降低见于脓毒症、重大烧伤、重大创伤和长期危重症,反映的是原发疾病本身。

items.function_short_zh: 作为蛋白质摄入的水解动物胶原蛋白。人体自身的胶原蛋白由普通氨基酸合成而来。
items.function_full_zh: 胶原蛋白是人体内含量最丰富的蛋白质,约占全身蛋白质总量的三分之一,构成皮肤、肌腱、韧带、骨基质、软骨和血管壁的张力支架。人体由普通氨基酸合成胶原蛋白,其序列是富含脯氨酸的重复Gly-X-Y序列。稳定三螺旋结构所需的翻译后羟基化由prolyl and lysyl hydroxylases完成,这一过程需要维生素C、铁和2-oxoglutarate。摄入的胶原蛋白会像其他蛋白质一样被消化,不过一些二肽和三肽,例如prolyl-hydroxyproline,确实能以完整形式进入血液,这被认为是其在提供氨基酸之外可能产生其他作用的机制。作为蛋白质来源,胶原蛋白在营养上并不完整:不含色氨酸,且其他几种必需氨基酸含量也偏低。
items.deficiency_name_zh: 无。坏血病有时被笼统地描述为胶原蛋白缺乏,这是一种误读:坏血病的本质是维生素C缺乏,受影响的胶原蛋白只是下游表现,根源在于缺少这一酶辅因子。
items.deficiency_early_zh: 不适用。胶原蛋白不是膳食必需成分,也不存在膳食性胶原蛋白缺乏。真正意义上的胶原蛋白功能障碍,来自维生素C缺乏(坏血病)、胶原蛋白基因的遗传性缺陷(osteogenesis imperfecta、Ehlers-Danlos综合征),或整体性的蛋白质能量营养不良。以上任何一种情况都不会因为摄入胶原蛋白而得到纠正。
items.at_risk_zh: 不适用。有一个理论上的论点值得一提,但不宜夸大:一项化学计量学分析计算得出,内源性甘氨酸合成加上典型膳食甘氨酸摄入量,比70 kg成年人实现最大胶原蛋白更新所需的量大约少10 g/day(PMID 20093739)。这仍只是一项计算结果。目前尚未在临床上证实存在甘氨酸或胶原蛋白缺乏状态。

items.function_short_zh: 一种可形成凝胶的纤维,能在粪便中保留水分,使其更软、更蓬松、更容易排出。
items.function_full_zh: 车前草壳(psyllium)是Plantago ovata种子经研磨制成的壳,主要成分是高度支化、可形成凝胶的阿拉伯木聚糖,而且与大多数黏性纤维不同,它很难被结肠细菌发酵。由于它能完整地到达直肠,水分也保留在那里,产生的粪便体积大且柔软,产气量远低于可发酵纤维。它能双向调节粪便性状,使硬便变软,使稀便变实。同样的凝胶还会提高小肠内容物的黏度,从而减慢葡萄糖吸收并结合胆汁酸,胆汁酸随之流失,促使肝脏利用胆固醇合成新的胆汁酸,进而降低LDL。在IBS中,它是真正有试验支持的纤维:ispaghula使IBS未改善的相对风险降至0.83(95% CI 0.73到0.94),所需治疗人数为7(95% CI 4到25),也是ACG指南推荐使用的纤维(PMID 33315591)。
items.deficiency_early_zh: 不存在车前草壳缺乏这回事,车前草壳只是纠正总膳食纤维不足的一种方式。膳食纤维摄入不足最先表现为大便变硬、排便次数减少、排便费力、全肠道通过时间延长以及粪便重量减少。
items.deficiency_severe_zh: 低纤维摄入并不会导致某种缺乏病。现有证据支持的是一种梯度关联:汇总185项前瞻性研究和58项试验后发现,纤维摄入最高组的全因死亡率和心血管死亡率比最低组低15%到30%,冠心病、卒中、2型糖尿病和结直肠癌的发病率也更低。风险降幅最大出现在摄入量为25到29 g/day的区间,剂量反应曲线提示摄入量超过30 g/day可能带来进一步获益,但这一点并未被证实(Reynolds et al., PMID 30638909)。未经治疗的慢性便秘本身可能进展为粪便嵌塞,罕见情况下还可发展为粪石性溃疡或穿孔。
items.reversibility_note_zh: 只要摄入充足,粪便性状、排便频率、通过时间以及对LDL和餐后血糖的影响,都会在数天到数周内恢复正常,一旦停止摄入又会恢复原状。死亡率和癌症方面的关联反映的是长期饮食模式,并非短期补充的效果,也没有任何试验证明纤维补充剂能逆转已经形成的结直肠肿瘤。
items.at_risk_zh: 就总膳食纤维摄入不足而言:大多数遵循西式饮食的人,尤其是以精制谷物为主、蔬菜豆类水果摄入很少的人,以及长期采用低渣饮食或限制性饮食的人。美国成年人的平均摄入量约为16 g/day,而适宜摄入量(AI)对年轻女性为25 g/day,对年轻男性为38 g/day。
items.prevalence_zh: 美国人群中大约5%达到纤维的适宜摄入量,7.4%的美国成年人达到每1000 kcal 14 g的标准,以上数据均来自NHANES,平均摄入量约为16 g/day。车前草壳本身没有单独的患病率或摄入量数据,因为它属于补充剂,不是天然营养素。

items.function_short_zh: 肠道细菌用来发酵的纤维,能提升双歧杆菌数量,并在结肠中产生短链脂肪酸。
items.function_full_zh: 菊粉和低聚果糖(FOS)都是来自菊苣根、菊芋、洋葱、大蒜和小麦的果糖聚合物,主要区别在于链长:FOS的聚合度约在9以下,菊粉则可延伸到60。低聚半乳糖(GOS)是由乳糖经酶促反应生成的半乳糖低聚物,在结构上类似于人乳低聚糖。这三者都能抵抗人体消化酶,完整到达结肠,并被选择性发酵,可重复地提升Bifidobacterium的丰度,这也是ISAPP将益生元定义为一种被宿主微生物选择性利用以带来健康益处的底物的依据(PMID 28611480)。发酵产生乙酸、丙酸和丁酸,丁酸是结肠上皮细胞的主要呼吸燃料,短链脂肪酸池还能降低肠腔pH并支持屏障功能。正是这种可发酵性带来了这类化合物常见的产气和腹胀,也是它们被归为高FODMAP食物的原因。
items.deficiency_early_zh: 不存在针对益生元本身的缺乏状态。可发酵底物摄入不足会降低结肠短链脂肪酸的产生,尤其是丁酸,并降低Bifidobacterium的丰度。这两项变化都可以在粪便中测得,但都不会产生本人能察觉到的症状。
items.deficiency_severe_zh: 人体中不存在严重的缺乏综合征。最有力的机制证据来自小鼠:在长期或间歇性纤维缺乏状态下,肠道菌群会转而降解宿主分泌的黏液糖蛋白,使结肠黏液屏障变薄,增加对肠道病原体的易感性(Desai et al., PMID 27863247)。这一现象尚未被证实会在人体中导致疾病。与低纤维摄入相关的人体结局,更适合在总膳食纤维层面进行评估,不局限于益生元本身。
items.reversibility_note_zh: Bifidobacterium丰度和短链脂肪酸产量在摄入后数天到大约一周内就会出现反应,停止摄入后也会在相近的时间内回落到基线水平附近。整个效应都依赖于持续摄入,一旦停止补充,菌群组成不会留下持久性的改变。
items.at_risk_zh: 洋葱、大蒜、韭葱、菊苣、小麦、香蕉或豆类摄入很少的人。因IBS而采用低FODMAP饮食的人恰恰限制了这些底物的摄入,并表现出可测得的Bifidobacterium下降,这也是限制阶段被设计为限时进行、之后需按结构化方式重新引入这些食物的原因。使用未添加GOS或FOS配方奶粉的婴儿则完全接触不到这些成分。
items.prevalence_zh: 无确切数据。益生元尚未设定摄入需求量,因此不存在相应的达标率数据。欧美人群菊粉型果聚糖的习惯摄入量估计约为1到10 g/day。

items.supplement: Wheat bran and insoluble fibre supplements for IBS
items.function_short_zh: 一种粗糙的不溶性纤维,通过机械方式增加粪便体积。在IBS中,它常常会使症状加重。
items.function_full_zh: 麦麸是小麦籽粒的外层,主要由不溶性阿拉伯木聚糖、纤维素和木质素组成。它的作用机制是颗粒体积和对黏膜的机械刺激,并不依靠形成凝胶:粗颗粒会增加粪便质量并刺激分泌和蠕动,而细磨的麦麸则失去这一效果,甚至可能减慢肠道通过。它的持水能力远低于车前草壳,且部分会被发酵,产生气体。在IBS患者中,这些特性反而对患者不利,因为机械刺激作用于本已敏感的肠道,而且麦麸还含有果聚糖,属于高FODMAP食物。荟萃分析发现,麦麸对IBS整体症状没有显著获益(未改善的相对风险为0.90,95% CI 0.79到1.03),与ispaghula(NNT为7)形成对比,ACG指南推荐IBS患者使用可溶性纤维(PMID 33315591)。
items.deficiency_early_zh: 不存在麦麸缺乏这回事。功能性这一标签适用于总膳食纤维:摄入不足会导致大便变硬、排便次数减少、排便费力、粪便重量减少以及全肠道通过时间延长。如果麦麸是某人唯一的纤维来源,停用麦麸就会重现这些表现。
items.deficiency_severe_zh: 不服用麦麸补充剂本身不会带来任何严重后果。一般性的低纤维关联依然适用:总纤维摄入最高组比最低组的全因死亡率和心血管死亡率低15%到30%,冠心病、卒中、2型糖尿病和结直肠癌的发病率也更低(PMID 30638909)。但在IBS患者中,更常见的临床问题恰恰相反。在100名连续就诊、曾尝试过麦麸的IBS患者中,55%报告症状因此加重,只有10%认为有帮助,肠道紊乱、腹胀和腹痛均有所加重(Francis and Whorwell, PMID 7912305)。
items.reversibility_note_zh: 改变不溶性纤维摄入量后,粪便体积、排便频率和通过时间会在数天内发生变化,停用后又会恢复原状。IBS患者因麦麸诱发的症状发作,在停用麦麸后会平息,目前也没有关于持久性黏膜或功能损害的报告。
items.at_risk_zh: 就总膳食纤维摄入不足而言:主要以精制谷物为主、植物性食物摄入很少的人群,美国成年人平均摄入量约为16 g/day,而适宜摄入量为25到38 g/day。就麦麸带来的伤害而言(区别于单纯的摄入不足):IBS患者是最常被建议使用麦麸、也最容易因此而症状加重的人群。
items.prevalence_zh: 美国大约5%的人群达到纤维的适宜摄入量,平均摄入量约为16 g/day(NHANES数据)。关于IBS患者对麦麸的不耐受,100名连续就诊的IBS患者中有55%报告服用麦麸后症状加重(PMID 7912305)。

items.function_short: Recycles ATP inside muscle and brain cells, buffering energy during short bursts of intense effort.
items.function_full: Creatine is phosphorylated by creatine kinase to phosphocreatine, a rapid-turnover phosphate reservoir that regenerates ATP from ADP during high-intensity contraction and in neurons. Roughly half of the daily turnover (about 1 to 3 g) is synthesized endogenously from arginine, glycine and methionine by AGAT and GAMT in liver, kidney and pancreas; the remainder comes from meat and fish. There is no dietary requirement. Vegetarians carry intramuscular creatine about 20 to 30 percent below omnivores and remain healthy, they simply respond more strongly to supplementation.
items.deficiency_name: Cerebral creatine deficiency syndromes: GAMT deficiency, AGAT deficiency and X-linked creatine transporter (SLC6A8) deficiency. These are inborn errors of metabolism. They are not caused by eating too little creatine, and no dietary pattern produces them.
items.deficiency_early: In the genetic disorders, onset is in infancy or early childhood: global developmental delay, expressive speech delay out of proportion to other skills, hypotonia, and in GAMT deficiency early epilepsy and a movement disorder. Brain magnetic resonance spectroscopy showing an absent or near-absent creatine peak is the diagnostic finding. In healthy people on low-meat diets the only detectable change is lower muscle and blood creatine, with no symptoms.
items.deficiency_severe: Untreated GAMT deficiency causes intractable seizures, autistic features, extrapyramidal movement disorder and severe intellectual disability, with accumulated guanidinoacetate contributing to the neurotoxicity. Creatine transporter deficiency causes lifelong moderate to severe intellectual disability and seizures in affected males.
items.reversibility_note: AGAT and GAMT deficiency respond to oral creatine (with arginine restriction and ornithine in GAMT). Children treated from birth after newborn screening can develop normally, which makes early detection the whole game; those treated after symptoms appear regain some function but retain a permanent deficit. Creatine transporter deficiency does not respond to oral creatine at all, because the transporter that would carry it into the brain is the broken protein.
items.at_risk: People with biallelic GATM or GAMT variants, or hemizygous SLC6A8 variants (males, X-linked). Nobody becomes creatine deficient from diet.
items.prevalence: GAMT deficiency approximately 1 in 250,000 newborns on Dutch newborn-screening pilot data, with published estimates ranging widely (roughly 1:115,000 to 1:2,600,000). Creatine transporter deficiency is found in about 0.4 to 2.6 percent of males with intellectual disability of unknown cause. Dietary creatine deficiency: no prevalence, because the state does not exist.
items.source: GeneReviews, Creatine Deficiency Disorders, NCBI Bookshelf NBK3794; PMID 29569535 (Blancquaert et al., Br J Nutr 2018, vegetarian diet and body creatine pool)

items.function_short: The raw material for carnosine, which buffers acid build-up in muscle during hard efforts.
items.function_full: Beta-alanine is the rate-limiting substrate for carnosine synthase, which joins it to histidine to form carnosine in skeletal muscle. Carnosine acts as an intracellular pH buffer across the physiological range and also chelates metals and scavenges reactive carbonyls. Several weeks of supplementation raise muscle carnosine by roughly 40 to 80 percent and produce a small performance gain in efforts lasting about 30 seconds to 10 minutes. The body forms beta-alanine from uracil degradation in the liver and also obtains it from meat-derived carnosine and anserine. It is a non-essential amino acid with no recommended intake.
items.source: PMID 26175657 (International Society of Sports Nutrition position stand: beta-alanine, J Int Soc Sports Nutr 2015)

items.function_short: Blocks the brain's sleepiness signal, so you feel more alert and effort feels easier.
items.function_full: Caffeine is an adenosine receptor antagonist, principally at A1 and A2A receptors. Blocking A1 lifts the inhibitory brake that accumulating adenosine places on arousal circuits, and blocking striatal A2A disinhibits dopaminergic signalling, which produces the alertness and the reduced perception of effort. It is a plant alkaloid and a xenobiotic. No human enzyme, receptor or pathway requires it, and there is no intake below which anything fails. Caffeine withdrawal is not a deficiency state: habitual intake upregulates adenosine receptors, so abrupt cessation unmasks adenosine signalling and produces headache, fatigue and low mood for roughly 2 to 9 days, with headache in about half of regular users. That is physical dependence on a drug, and it resolves completely without resuming the drug.
items.source: PMID 15448977 (Juliano & Griffiths, critical review of caffeine withdrawal, Psychopharmacology 2004); EFSA Scientific Opinion on the safety of caffeine, EFSA Journal 2015;13(5):4102

items.function_short: A leucine metabolite that slows muscle protein loss during illness, bed rest or ageing.
items.function_full: Beta-hydroxy-beta-methylbutyrate is a downstream metabolite of the amino acid leucine. About 5 percent of leucine catabolism proceeds through ketoisocaproate to HMB, so an ordinary diet supplies only a few hundred milligrams a day and the body generates the rest internally. Its main described action is suppression of muscle proteolysis through the ubiquitin-proteasome pathway, with a weaker effect on mTOR-mediated protein synthesis than leucine itself. Clinical interest sits in muscle-wasting settings such as bed rest, older adults and cancer cachexia. It is a metabolite of an essential amino acid, not an essential nutrient in its own right.
items.source: PMID 23374455 (International Society of Sports Nutrition position stand: beta-hydroxy-beta-methylbutyrate, J Int Soc Sports Nutr 2013)

items.function_short: Quercetin is a plant pigment with no bodily role; taurine supports bile, heart and retina.
items.function_full: These are two unrelated molecules sold together for convenience. Quercetin is a plant flavonol from onions, capers, apples and tea; it is heavily glucuronidated and sulfated on first pass, so free aglycone concentrations in plasma stay in the nanomolar range and most antioxidant actions demonstrated in cell culture cannot occur at achievable oral doses. Taurine is a sulfur-containing beta-amino acid, the most abundant free amino acid in heart, retina and leukocytes. It conjugates bile acids, stabilises membranes, modulates calcium handling and cell volume, and is required for the mitochondrial tRNA modification that supports respiratory chain protein synthesis. Adults synthesize taurine from cysteine via cysteine sulfinic acid decarboxylase and obtain roughly 40 to 400 mg a day from meat and seafood.
items.deficiency_name: NONE. There is no named deficiency disease for either compound, and quercetin has no deficiency state of any kind. Taurine is classified as conditionally essential, and documented human depletion is confined to patients fed on taurine-free parenteral nutrition.
items.deficiency_early: Applies to taurine only, and only in people fed exclusively by taurine-free intravenous nutrition. The earliest change is a fall in plasma taurine (about 26 versus 57 micromol/L in affected children) followed by delayed rod and cone implicit times on electroretinography, detectable before the patient notices any visual problem.
items.deficiency_severe: In children on prolonged taurine-free parenteral nutrition, all eight studied had abnormal electroretinograms indicating retinal dysfunction. Taurine depletion also contributes to parenteral-nutrition-associated cholestasis in infants. Nothing comparable has been described in anyone eating ordinary food, and no severe state exists for quercetin.
items.reversibility_note: Adding taurine to the intravenous solution restored plasma taurine in four children studied and normalised the electroretinogram in three of those four, so the retinal dysfunction is largely correctable. The evidence base is a small case series, and paediatric parenteral amino acid solutions now routinely contain taurine, which prevents the problem in the first place.
items.at_risk: Patients on long-term parenteral nutrition without added taurine, particularly preterm infants and children with intestinal failure. Nobody becomes quercetin deficient, and nobody eating food becomes taurine deficient.
items.prevalence: NOT ESTABLISHED as a population figure. Taurine depletion is restricted to the parenteral nutrition population and is largely eliminated by current formulations. For quercetin there is no figure because there is no deficiency.
items.source: PMID 3917547 (Geggel et al., nutritional requirement for taurine in long-term parenteral nutrition, N Engl J Med 1985); PMID 2122712 (visual function in patients on long-term total parenteral nutrition)

items.function_short: A building block cells use to make NAD+, the coenzyme that keeps energy metabolism running.
items.function_full: Nicotinamide mononucleotide is an intermediate in the NAD+ salvage pathway, formed when nicotinamide phosphoribosyltransferase attaches nicotinamide to phosphoribosyl pyrophosphate, then converted to NAD+ by NMN adenylyltransferases. NAD+ is the electron carrier for hundreds of dehydrogenases and the consumed substrate for sirtuins, PARPs and CD38. Oral NMN is largely dephosphorylated to nicotinamide riboside in the gut before absorption in humans, so it raises NAD+ by the same route as other precursors. NMN itself is not an essential nutrient and has no recommended intake. The essential nutrient in this pathway is niacin (vitamin B3), whose deficiency causes pellagra, a real and severe disease that has nothing to do with NMN intake.
items.source: PMID 29514064 (Rajman, Chwalek & Sinclair, Cell Metab 2018); NIH Office of Dietary Supplements, Niacin Fact Sheet for Health Professionals (pellagra)

items.function_short: A form of vitamin B3 that cells convert into NAD+, the energy metabolism coenzyme.
items.function_full: Nicotinamide riboside is the riboside of nicotinamide, phosphorylated by nicotinamide riboside kinases to NMN and then to NAD+, bypassing the NAMPT step. It occurs naturally in trace amounts in milk. Single oral doses raise whole-blood NAD+ dose-dependently in humans, which is the basis for marketing it as an NAD+ booster; whether raising NAD+ produces clinical benefit in healthy people remains unsettled. NR is a minor chemical form of vitamin B3 rather than a separate essential nutrient. Vitamin B3 deficiency does exist and is called pellagra (dermatitis, diarrhoea, dementia), but it results from lack of dietary niacin and tryptophan and is treated with nicotinamide or nicotinic acid, not with NR.
items.source: PMID 27721479 (Trammell et al., Nat Commun 2016, oral bioavailability of nicotinamide riboside); NIH Office of Dietary Supplements, Niacin Fact Sheet for Health Professionals

items.function_short: A stress compound made by grapevines. It has no established job in human physiology.
items.function_full: Resveratrol is a stilbene phytoalexin produced by grapevines, Japanese knotweed and peanuts in response to injury and fungal attack. In cell and yeast systems it appears to activate SIRT1, an effect later shown to depend substantially on the fluorophore-tagged assay substrate rather than on the enzyme, and it activates AMPK at high concentrations. In humans absorption is good but bioavailability is very low: it is almost completely converted to sulfate and glucuronide conjugates on first pass, leaving free plasma resveratrol far below the concentrations used in cell experiments. It is a plant secondary metabolite. No human transporter, receptor or enzyme requires it, and nothing in the body fails in its absence.
items.source: PMID 15333514 (Walle et al., high absorption but very low bioavailability of oral resveratrol in humans, Drug Metab Dispos 2004); Linus Pauling Institute Micronutrient Information Center, Resveratrol

items.function_short: A polyamine your own cells make, needed to activate a key protein-building factor.
items.function_full: Spermidine is a polyamine synthesized from putrescine by spermidine synthase using decarboxylated S-adenosylmethionine. Its one indispensable and unique function is donating the aminobutyl group for hypusination of eukaryotic translation initiation factor 5A, a modification required to translate polyproline-containing proteins. It also stabilises nucleic acids and induces autophagy in model organisms, which is the basis of the longevity marketing. Humans get it from three simultaneous sources: de novo synthesis in essentially every cell, gut bacterial production, and food such as wheat germ, aged cheese, soy and mushrooms. Because synthesis is ubiquitous and tightly regulated, dietary intake is never limiting and no deficiency state exists.
items.source: DOI 10.1126/science.aan2788 (Madeo, Eisenberg, Pietrocola & Kroemer, Spermidine in health and disease, Science 2018)

items.function_short: Carries electrons in the mitochondrial energy chain and protects cell membranes from oxidation.
items.function_full: Coenzyme Q10 is a lipid-soluble benzoquinone with a ten-unit isoprenoid tail. In the inner mitochondrial membrane it shuttles electrons from complexes I and II to complex III, and it is also the electron acceptor for dihydroorotate dehydrogenase in pyrimidine synthesis and for fatty acid beta-oxidation through ETF-QO. Its reduced form, ubiquinol, is the main lipid-phase antioxidant of membranes and regenerates vitamin E. Humans synthesize it through the mevalonate pathway, the same pathway statins inhibit, and food contributes only a few milligrams a day. It is not a vitamin and there is no dietary requirement.
items.deficiency_name: Primary coenzyme Q10 deficiency (COQ10D1 to COQ10D10), an autosomal recessive inborn error of CoQ10 biosynthesis caused by variants in PDSS1, PDSS2, COQ2, COQ4, COQ5, COQ6, COQ7, COQ8A, COQ8B or COQ9. This is a genetic disorder of synthesis, not a consequence of low dietary intake.
items.deficiency_early: In the genetic disorder, presentation spans the neonatal period to the seventh decade: steroid-resistant nephrotic syndrome with proteinuria, cerebellar ataxia, exercise intolerance and muscle weakness, or encephalopathy with seizures. Diagnosis rests on CoQ10 measurement in muscle or fibroblasts plus genetic testing. Separately and far more commonly, statins lower circulating CoQ10 by roughly 16 to 54 percent, which is a laboratory change rather than this disease.
items.deficiency_severe: Severe neonatal-onset forms cause fatal multisystem disease with encephalopathy, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and renal failure. Later-onset forms progress to cerebellar atrophy with disabling ataxia, or to end-stage kidney disease from steroid-resistant nephrotic syndrome.
items.reversibility_note: High-dose oral CoQ10 can block progression of the kidney disease and improve some myopathic and encephalopathic features, and works best when started before damage is established. Established severe neurological or renal damage does not reverse, and neonatal-onset disease responds poorly, partly because CoQ10 penetrates the blood-brain barrier badly.
items.at_risk: People with biallelic pathogenic variants in a COQ pathway gene. Secondary reduction of blood CoQ10 occurs with statin therapy and with ageing, but that is a biochemical finding and does not produce this clinical picture; trials of CoQ10 for statin-associated muscle symptoms have given conflicting results.
items.prevalence: NOT ESTABLISHED. Primary CoQ10 deficiency is ultra-rare, with GeneReviews noting that prevalence data are limited by the small number of affected individuals reported, ranging from 2 to just over 10 families per causative gene. Statin-associated reduction in circulating CoQ10 of 16 to 54 percent is common but is a different thing entirely.
items.source: GeneReviews, Primary Coenzyme Q10 Deficiency Overview, NCBI Bookshelf NBK410087; Banach et al., effect of statin treatment on circulating coenzyme Q10 concentrations, meta-analysis, PMC6230224

items.function_short: A cofactor mitochondria build and clip onto the enzymes that burn carbohydrate and amino acids.
items.function_full: Lipoic acid functions as a covalently bound prosthetic group (lipoamide) on the E2 subunits of pyruvate dehydrogenase, alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase, branched-chain ketoacid dehydrogenase and the glycine cleavage system, where its dithiolane ring carries acyl groups and reducing equivalents. Humans make it de novo inside mitochondria via lipoic acid synthase and attach it enzymatically to apoproteins; free lipoate from food or capsules is never used for this. Rare biallelic LIAS, LIPT1 or LIPT2 variants cause a severe neonatal encephalopathy with lactic acidosis and hyperglycinaemia, and oral lipoic acid does not rescue the lipoylation defect in patients or in patient fibroblasts, which is precisely why that genetic disorder is not a deficiency of the supplement molecule. Supplemental alpha-lipoic acid therefore acts only as a free redox-active compound, unrelated to the cofactor role, and its best evidence is symptomatic relief in diabetic polyneuropathy.
items.source: DOI 10.1007/s10545-014-9705-8 (Mayr et al., Lipoic acid biosynthesis defects, J Inherit Metab Dis 2014); PMID 17065669 (Ziegler et al., SYDNEY 2 trial, Diabetes Care 2006)

items.function_short: A small sulfur molecule sold for joint pain; no body process is known to need it.
items.function_full: Methylsulfonylmethane is dimethyl sulfone, the oxidised metabolite of dimethyl sulfoxide, present in trace amounts in some foods and in the marine sulfur cycle. It is well absorbed and distributes widely, including into cerebrospinal fluid, and a fraction of its sulfur can enter the methionine and cysteine pools. That contribution is trivial next to dietary protein, which supplies all the sulfur amino acid a person needs. Proposed anti-inflammatory effects via NF-kB inhibition come from cell and animal work, and human osteoarthritis trials are small and short. Sulfur as an element is essential; MSM as a molecule is not, and no human enzyme or structure uses it.
items.source: PMID 28300758 (Butawan, Benjamin & Bloomer, Methylsulfonylmethane: applications and safety of a novel dietary supplement, Nutrients 2017, DOI 10.3390/nu9030290)

items.function_short: A red algal pigment that sits inside cell membranes. Humans have no requirement for it.
items.function_full: Astaxanthin is a xanthophyll carotenoid produced by the microalga Haematococcus pluvialis and concentrated up the food chain into salmon, trout, shrimp and flamingo feathers. Polar keto and hydroxyl groups on both ionone rings let the molecule span the lipid bilayer, which underlies claims that it quenches singlet oxygen and lipid radicals more efficiently than beta-carotene. Unlike beta-carotene it has no provitamin A activity in humans: it is not cleaved to retinal and cannot contribute to vitamin A status. Humans cannot synthesize it and have no need to, since no metabolic process requires it and no intake recommendation exists.
items.source: PMID 7562082 (Jyonouchi et al., astaxanthin, a carotenoid without vitamin A activity, Nutr Cancer 1995); EFSA Panel opinion on the safety of astaxanthin, EFSA Journal 2019

items.function_short: The yellow pigment of turmeric. A spice compound, with no role in human physiology.
items.function_full: Curcumin is a diarylheptanoid pigment making up roughly 2 to 5 percent of turmeric rhizome. It binds and weakly inhibits a very large number of unrelated proteins in vitro, which is why it appears in thousands of papers; medicinal chemists classify it as a pan-assay interference compound, since its chemical reactivity, aggregation and fluorescence generate false positives across screening assays. Unformulated curcumin is poorly absorbed, rapidly glucuronidated and sulfated, and essentially undetectable as the free compound in plasma even after gram doses, though piperine, phospholipid and nanoparticle formulations raise exposure. It is a plant secondary metabolite with no physiological role in humans and no requirement.
items.source: PMID 28074653 (Nelson et al., The Essential Medicinal Chemistry of Curcumin, J Med Chem 2017)

items.function_short: A tea polyphenol the body does not need; concentrated extracts can injure the liver.
items.function_full: Epigallocatechin-3-gallate is the dominant catechin of green tea. It is poorly absorbed, extensively methylated, glucuronidated and sulfated, and degraded by gut microbiota, leaving free plasma EGCG in the sub-micromolar range. Proposed actions include inhibition of catechol-O-methyltransferase, modest effects on fat oxidation and binding to the 67 kDa laminin receptor, none of which establish any physiological requirement. The important safety fact runs the other way: concentrated extracts, especially taken while fasting, cause idiosyncratic hepatocellular injury, with published cases spanning intakes of roughly 140 to 1000 mg EGCG per day and a strong association with the HLA-B*35:01 allele. Brewed tea as a beverage is not implicated at these concentrations.
items.source: Oketch-Rabah et al., United States Pharmacopeia comprehensive review of the hepatotoxicity of green tea extracts, Toxicol Rep 2020;7:386-402; NIH LiverTox, Green Tea, NCBI Bookshelf NBK547925

items.function_short: Cartilage building blocks your own cells make from glucose, so eating them is not required.
items.function_full: Glucosamine is an amino sugar produced in every cell from fructose-6-phosphate by glutamine-fructose-6-phosphate amidotransferase, the entry step of the hexosamine biosynthetic pathway that supplies UDP-N-acetylglucosamine for glycosaminoglycans, proteoglycans and O-GlcNAc signalling. Chondroitin sulfate is a sulfated glycosaminoglycan chain assembled on proteoglycan core proteins in the Golgi. Both are made on demand from glucose and glutamine, so neither is a required dietary component and neither has a recommended intake. Orally administered chondroitin is a large polysaccharide with low and variable absorption, and oral glucosamine does not raise synovial fluid concentrations anywhere near those used in cartilage cell experiments. The real question is efficacy rather than nutritional need: the NIH GAIT trial found no significant benefit over placebo for knee osteoarthritis pain in the overall study population.
items.source: PMID 16495392 (Clegg et al., Glucosamine, chondroitin sulfate, and the two in combination for painful knee osteoarthritis, N Engl J Med 2006)

items.function_short: Not a nutrient. This is the practice of taking antioxidant pills while on chemotherapy.
items.function_full: This entry is a clinical scenario rather than a substance, and there is no antioxidant deficiency to correct. Anthracyclines, platinum agents, alkylating agents and radiotherapy kill tumour cells partly through reactive oxygen species and oxidative DNA damage, so high-dose antioxidants taken concurrently could in principle shield the tumour along with normal tissue, and tumour cells themselves often depend on antioxidant defences to survive. In the largest prospective dataset, 1,134 women in the SWOG S0221 adjuvant breast cancer trial, self-reported use of any antioxidant supplement (vitamin A, C or E, carotenoids or coenzyme Q10) both before and during chemotherapy was associated with a borderline increase in recurrence (adjusted hazard ratio 1.41, 95% CI 0.98 to 2.04, P = .06) and in death (adjusted hazard ratio 1.40, 95% CI 0.90 to 2.18, P = .14), with separately significant signals for vitamin B12 and for iron. These associations are observational within a randomised trial cohort and both antioxidant confidence intervals cross 1, so this is a well-founded caution rather than proof of harm, and it underpins oncology advice to avoid supplements other than a standard multivitamin during treatment unless a specific deficiency has been diagnosed.
items.source: PMID 31855498, DOI 10.1200/JCO.19.01203 (Ambrosone et al., Dietary Supplement Use During Chemotherapy and Survival Outcomes, SWOG S0221, J Clin Oncol 2020;38:804-814)

errors.field: prevalence (and the same claim repeated in deficiency_early)
errors.correction: Two compounding faults in one claim. (a) Misattributed source: PMC6230224 is Qu H, Meng Y, Chai H, et al., 'The effect of statin treatment on circulating coenzyme Q10 concentrations: an updated meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials', Eur J Med Res 2018 — not Banach et al. (b) Neither meta-analysis reports percentages at all: Qu 2018 gives SMD -2.12 (95% CI -3.40 to -0.84, p=0.001), and the real Banach meta-analysis (Pharmacol Res 2015, PMID 26192349) gives WMD -0.44 micromol/L (95% CI -0.52 to -0.37). The '16 to 54 percent' range actually originates in Marcoff & Thompson, JACC 2007;49:2231-2237, a narrative systematic review summarising 9 observational studies and 6 RCTs. Either re-cite Marcoff & Thompson for the percentage range, or restate the effect as the meta-analytic WMD of -0.44 micromol/L. The largest single trial in Marcoff & Thompson (n=1,049) found 38% and 27% reductions with atorvastatin and lovastatin respectively.
errors.source: Qu et al., Eur J Med Res 2018, PMC6230224; Banach et al., Pharmacol Res 2015, PMID 26192349; Marcoff & Thompson, J Am Coll Cardiol 2007;49:2231-2237

errors.correction: The sentence inverts endogenous and dietary contributions. It reads 'an ordinary diet supplies only a few hundred milligrams a day and the body generates the rest internally.' In fact the few hundred milligrams IS the endogenous figure: at ordinary protein intakes the body produces roughly 0.2 to 0.4 g HMB per day from the ~5 percent of dietary leucine that flows through ketoisocaproate. Preformed HMB in food (grapefruit, catfish, alfalfa, corn silage) is present only in milligram quantities and contributes essentially nothing. The cited ISSN stand makes the point the other way round: 'an individual would need to consume over 600 g of high quality protein to obtain the amount of leucine (60 grams) necessary to produce the typical 3 g daily dosage of HMB.' Suggested rewrite: 'the body produces only about 0.2 to 0.4 g a day from dietary leucine, and preformed HMB in food is negligible.' The 5 percent conversion figure and the NONE classification are both correct and unaffected.
errors.source: Wilson et al., ISSN Position Stand: beta-hydroxy-beta-methylbutyrate, J Int Soc Sports Nutr 2013, PMID 23374455, PMC3568064

errors.correction: 'approximately 1 in 250,000 newborns on Dutch newborn-screening pilot data' is not supported. There is no Dutch GAMT newborn-screening pilot in the evidence base; the AAP/Pediatrics 2023 evidence review that underpins GAMT screening recommendations does not mention one. The 1:250,000 figure is the UPPER BOUND of an estimated range (~0.038 to 0.4 per 100,000 live births, i.e. 1:2,600,000 to 1:250,000) derived from pathogenic-allele frequencies in deidentified dried blood spots, not a point estimate from any screening pilot. Actual prospective newborn screening in Utah and New York detected 1:405,655. The stated lower bound of '1:115,000' is the single weakest estimate in the literature: it comes from 5 patients referred to one treatment centre between 2001 and 2011 and should be labelled as such rather than presented as a symmetric bound. Suggested rewrite: 'GeneReviews gives an estimated incidence of 1:2,640,000 to 1:250,000; prospective newborn screening in Utah and New York found 1:405,655; a single-centre referral series of 5 patients produced a much higher outlier estimate of 1:114,000.'
errors.source: GeneReviews, Creatine Deficiency Disorders, NBK3794; Pediatrics 2023;152(2):e2023062100, PMC10527896, PMID 37465909

errors.correction: 'Vegetarians carry intramuscular creatine about 20 to 30 percent below omnivores' exceeds what the cited source shows. Blancquaert et al. 2018 is an intervention trial in 40 omnivorous women, not a cross-sectional vegetarian-versus-omnivore comparison, and it found vastus lateralis total creatine fell 15 percent over 3 months in the vegetarian-plus-placebo arm (against +9.7 percent vegetarian-plus-creatine and +6.8 percent omnivorous control). Cross-sectional comparisons of habitual vegetarians report a smaller gap, around 10 percent (Burke et al.). The 20 to 30 percent figure circulates mainly in supplement marketing, derived from a loose ~100 versus ~120 mmol/kg dry mass contrast that is itself only about 17 percent. Suggested correction: 'roughly 10 to 15 percent below omnivores.' The downstream inference (vegetarians remain healthy and respond more strongly to supplementation) survives the correction intact.
errors.source: Blancquaert et al., Br J Nutr 2018;119(7):759-770, PMID 29569535; Burke et al., Med Sci Sports Exerc 2003

errors.correction: 'Creatine transporter deficiency is found in about 0.4 to 2.6 percent of males with intellectual disability of unknown cause' welds together two different denominators under one label. GeneReviews reports 0.4 to 1.4 percent across cohorts of males with intellectual disability; the 2.64 percent figure comes from a separate, more recent cohort of individuals with neurodevelopmental disorders, which is neither male-restricted nor restricted to intellectual disability of unknown cause. Presenting 2.6 percent as the top of a range explicitly labelled 'males with intellectual disability of unknown cause' inflates the ceiling for that population by roughly twofold. Report the two figures separately with their populations attached.
errors.source: GeneReviews, Creatine Deficiency Disorders, NBK3794

errors.correction: The science is right but the cited source does not contain it. The ISSN 2015 position stand's Statement 4 says benefit is 'more pronounced in open end-point tasks/time trials lasting 1 to 4 min in duration', not 'about 30 seconds to 10 minutes'. The 0.5 to 10 minute window is the finding of Saunders et al., Br J Sports Med 2017;51:658-669 (40 studies, 1,461 subjects), which found the greatest effect at 0.5 to 10 min, no benefit below 30 s, and a non-significant moderate effect beyond 10 min. Same problem with the carnosine figure: the ISSN stand reports increases of up to 64 percent at 4 weeks and up to 80 percent at 10 weeks, so the 80 percent ceiling is supported but the 40 percent floor is not in the cited document. Add the Saunders 2017 citation alongside the ISSN stand.
errors.source: Trexler et al., ISSN Position Stand: beta-alanine, J Int Soc Sports Nutr 2015, PMID 26175657, PMC4501114; Saunders et al., Br J Sports Med 2017;51:658-669

errors.correction: 'Oral NMN is largely dephosphorylated to nicotinamide riboside in the gut before absorption in humans' asserts as settled a mechanism for which there is no human evidence. Direct intestinal NMN uptake via Slc12a8 was reported in MOUSE small intestine (Grozio et al., Nat Metab 2019) and was then disputed on methodological grounds (Shats et al., 'Absence of evidence that Slc12a8 encodes a nicotinamide mononucleotide transporter', Nat Metab 2020). The competing CD73 dephosphorylation route is an inference from extracellular NMN handling, and no human transporter has been demonstrated in either direction. The cited Rajman/Sinclair Cell Metab 2018 review predates both papers and cannot support the claim. Strike 'in humans' or rewrite as: 'NMN is thought to be dephosphorylated to nicotinamide riboside before cellular uptake, though the human intestinal route is not established and the proposed direct NMN transporter is contested.' The NONE classification is unaffected.
errors.source: Grozio et al., Nat Metab 2019;1:47-57; Shats et al., Nat Metab 2020;2:1200-1203; Rajman, Chwalek & Sinclair, Cell Metab 2018, PMID 29514064

errors.correction: PMID 7562082 is Jyonouchi H, Sun S, Tomita Y, Gross MD, 'Astaxanthin, a carotenoid without vitamin A activity, augments antibody responses in cultures including T-helper cell clones and suboptimal doses of antigen', J Nutr 1995;125(10):2483-92. The dataset cites the journal as 'Nutr Cancer 1995'. The PMID, authors and title are right; the journal is wrong. Change to J Nutr 1995. The no-provitamin-A-activity claim it is cited for is genuinely supported by that paper.
errors.source: PubMed record for PMID 7562082 (J Nutr 1995;125(10):2483-92)

misclassified.why: Priority-3 failure: a genetic disorder is occupying the dietary-deficiency slot. Creatine is not an essential nutrient, and the entry itself says so twice ('There is no dietary requirement', 'Nobody becomes creatine deficient from diet'). Everything the CLINICAL label rests on is a set of inborn errors of metabolism in GATM, GAMT and SLC6A8. The dataset's own alpha-lipoic acid entry handles the structurally identical situation correctly: LIAS/LIPT1/LIPT2 defects are described in function_full, deficiency_state is set to NONE, and the entry states outright that the genetic disorder 'is not a deficiency of the supplement molecule'. Creatine should follow that template. The prose here is honest, so this is a labelling failure rather than a content failure, but the label is what a reader filters and sorts on, and CLINICAL on a creatine row reads as an endorsement of supplementation for a deficiency that no diet can produce. Keep the entire genetic narrative in function_full and the deficiency_name field where it is informative.

Same priority-3 failure as creatine, and the same internal inconsistency with alpha-lipoic acid. CoQ10 is not a vitamin, food supplies only a few milligrams a day, and the entry states plainly 'there is no dietary requirement' and that primary CoQ10 deficiency 'is a genetic disorder of synthesis, not a consequence of low dietary intake'. Primary CoQ10 deficiency is a defect in ten biosynthesis genes. There is no dietary CoQ10 deficiency state at all. The risk is sharper here than for creatine because the entry also carries a genuinely common finding, the statin-associated fall in circulating CoQ10, and a CLINICAL label sitting above that pairing invites exactly the inference the entry elsewhere works hard to block, that statin users have a deficiency needing correction. The entry's own hedging ('that is a biochemical finding and does not produce this clinical picture') is undercut by its own top-level label.

misclassified.should_be: NONE, or split the row into two entries
misclassified.why: Priority-1 violation: quercetin is on the must-be-NONE list and this row tags it FUNCTIONAL. The row is also self-contradicting, since deficiency_name opens with the word 'NONE' while deficiency_state says FUNCTIONAL. Bundling a plant flavonol with no deficiency state of any kind together with a conditionally essential amino acid, then applying one label to the pair, means a reader scanning the field sees quercetin carrying a functional deficiency. The taurine evidence is real and I verified it exactly (Geggel 1985: plasma taurine 26 +/- 13 versus 57 +/- 16 micromol/L, abnormal ERG in all 8 children tested, plasma normalised in 4 supplemented children with ERG normalised in 3 of those 4), but it is iatrogenic depletion in taurine-free parenteral nutrition, not a dietary deficiency in anyone eating food, and the entry concedes modern paediatric formulations have largely eliminated it. Splitting the row is the better fix: quercetin NONE / reversibility NA, taurine FUNCTIONAL restricted to the parenteral-nutrition population. If the row must stay merged, NONE is the safer label. Note also that the FULL reversibility rests on 3 of 4 children in a 1985 case series, with plasma taurine relapsing in 2 of 3 a year after intravenous taurine was stopped; PARTIAL would be the more defensible grade if the taurine row survives as FUNCTIONAL.

chk.coverage: CLEAN. All 17 assigned names present exactly once, no duplicates, no extras. Item count matches the assigned list exactly.
chk.net:
Structurally the strongest group I would expect from this axis, undermined by three label decisions and one bad citation chain. Priority 1 is mostly clean: curcumin, resveratrol, astaxanthin, EGCG, MSM and spermidine are all correctly NONE, and their prose is genuinely good adversarial writing (curcumin flagged as PAINS, resveratrol's SIRT1 activation traced to the fluorophore artifact, spermidine's ubiquitous synthesis explained as the reason no deficiency can exist, MSM's sulfur contribution correctly dismissed as trivial next to dietary protein). Quercetin is the single Priority-1 breach, and it happens through row-bundling rather than through a substantive claim.

Priority 3 is where the group leaks. Creatine and CoQ10 both carry CLINICAL labels built entirely on inborn errors of metabolism. Both entries are textually honest about this, which makes the mislabelling more frustrating, since the dataset already contains the correct pattern in its own alpha-lipoic acid entry, which describes LIAS/LIPT1/LIPT2 disease in full and still returns NONE with an explicit statement of why. Applying that same rule to creatine and CoQ10 costs nothing and removes the only two CLINICAL labels in the group that a reader could act on wrongly.

Priority 2 is quiet here for a structural reason worth stating: no essential nutrient appears in this group, so once the three mislabels are corrected almost every reversibility field becomes NA and the field carries little actionable weight. The named test cases (B12 subacute combined degeneration, iodine in fetal development, scurvy) do not fall in this group. Of the three non-NA reversibility grades, CoQ10 PARTIAL is accurate against GeneReviews, creatine PARTIAL correctly captures that AGAT and GAMT respond while SLC6A8 does not, and taurine FULL is the one soft grade, resting on 3 of 4 children in a 1985 case series with relapse after withdrawal.

Priority 4 produced eight findings, two of them serious. The HMB sentence is a straight inversion of endogenous versus dietary supply. The CoQ10 statin figure is the worst citation in the group: a percentage range that appears in neither the meta-analysis cited nor the one whose authors are named, attached to a PMC ID belonging to a different paper by different authors. Both the creatine prevalence attribution (a Dutch screening pilot that does not exist) and the beta-alanine duration window (correct science, wrong source) are the same species of fault, a real number bolted to a source that does not contain it.

Substantial verification came back clean and deserves recording. Exact matches to primary sources: the Geggel taurine numbers down to the standard deviations and the 3-of-4 ERG normalisation; SWOG S0221 at n=1,134 with HR 1.41 (0.98-2.04, P=.06) for recurrence and 1.40 (0.90-2.18) for death; the USP green tea range of 140 to ~1000 mg EGCG per day plus the fasting-bioavailability mechanism; Juliano and Griffiths at 50 percent headache incidence and 2 to 9 days duration; GeneReviews CoQ10 families-per-gene at 2 to >10; and eight of nine spot-checked PMIDs correct in title, author, journal and year. The GAIT characterisation is properly hedged to the overall study population rather than the moderate-to-severe subgroup, which is the honest reading. The creatine early-treatment claim, which I initially suspected of optimism, is in fact supported: 7 of 8 infants treated before 6 months had normal developmental outcomes.

Fix order: the three deficiency_state labels first (they are one-word edits with the largest effect on how a reader acts), then the HMB inversion and the CoQ10 statin citation, then the four remaining source-attribution corrections."

items.function_short_zh: 在肌肉和脑细胞内循环再生ATP,在短时间高强度用力时起能量缓冲作用。
items.function_full_zh: 肌酸经肌酸激酶磷酸化为磷酸肌酸,这是一个周转迅速的磷酸库,在高强度收缩期间以及神经元中将ADP重新生成为ATP。每日周转量中大约一半(约1至3克)由肝、肾和胰腺中的AGAT和GAMT以精氨酸、甘氨酸和蛋氨酸为原料内源合成,其余来自肉类和鱼类。膳食摄入并非必需。素食者肌内肌酸水平比杂食者低约10%至15%,但仍保持健康,只是对补充剂的反应更强。
items.deficiency_name_zh: 脑肌酸缺乏综合征:GAMT缺乏症、AGAT缺乏症以及X连锁肌酸转运蛋白(SLC6A8)缺乏症。这些是先天性代谢缺陷,并非因肌酸摄入不足所致,任何饮食模式都不会导致这些疾病。
items.deficiency_early_zh: 在这些遗传性疾病中,发病始于婴幼儿期或儿童早期:全面发育迟缓、表达性语言迟缓(明显重于其他能力)、肌张力低下,GAMT缺乏症患者还早期出现癫痫和运动障碍。诊断依据是脑磁共振波谱显示肌酸峰缺失或近乎缺失。在肉类摄入较少的健康人群中,唯一可检测到的变化是肌肉和血液中肌酸水平降低,没有任何症状。
items.deficiency_severe_zh: 未经治疗的GAMT缺乏症会导致顽固性癫痫发作、孤独症样表现、锥体外系运动障碍和重度智力障碍,蓄积的胍基乙酸参与了神经毒性作用。肌酸转运蛋白缺乏症会使受累男性终生患有中度至重度智力障碍并伴有癫痫发作。
items.reversibility_note_zh: AGAT和GAMT缺乏症对口服肌酸有反应(GAMT缺乏症还需限制精氨酸并补充鸟氨酸)。经新生儿筛查后自出生起即接受治疗的儿童可正常发育,这使得早期发现成为关键所在;症状出现后才开始治疗的患儿可恢复部分功能,但会留下永久性缺陷。肌酸转运蛋白缺乏症对口服肌酸完全没有反应,因为本该将肌酸转运入脑的蛋白质本身就是损坏的那个蛋白。
items.at_risk_zh: 携带GATM或GAMT双等位基因变异者,或携带SLC6A8半合子变异者(男性,X连锁)。没有人会因饮食而导致肌酸缺乏。
items.prevalence_zh: GAMT缺乏症:GeneReviews给出的估计发病率为1:2,640,000至1:250,000;犹他州和纽约州的前瞻性新生儿筛查发现发病率为1:405,655;一项纳入5名患者的单中心转诊病例系列得出了明显偏高的估计值1:114,000。肌酸转运蛋白缺乏症在多项队列研究中,见于约0.4%至1.4%病因不明的智力障碍男性;另一项较新的独立队列研究(纳入神经发育障碍患者,并不限于男性,也不限于病因不明的智力障碍)发现比例为2.64%。膳食性肌酸缺乏:无发生率数据,因为这种状态并不存在。

items.function_short_zh: 合成肌肽的原料,肌肽可在剧烈运动时缓冲肌肉内的酸性物质堆积。
items.function_full_zh: β-丙氨酸是肌肽合酶的限速底物,该酶将其与组氨酸结合,在骨骼肌中生成肌肽。肌肽在生理范围内起细胞内pH缓冲作用,还能螯合金属并清除活性羰基化合物。补充数周后,肌肉肌肽水平可提高约40%至80%,并在持续约30秒至10分钟的运动中带来小幅的表现提升。人体内的β-丙氨酸由肝脏中尿嘧啶降解生成,也可从肉类中的肌肽和鹅肌肽获取。它是一种非必需氨基酸,没有推荐摄入量。

items.function_short_zh: 阻断大脑的困倦信号,使人感觉更清醒,也让费力的事情显得不那么费力。
items.function_full_zh: 咖啡因是腺苷受体拮抗剂,主要作用于A1和A2A受体。阻断A1受体可解除不断累积的腺苷对唤醒回路施加的抑制性制动,阻断纹状体A2A受体则解除对多巴胺信号的抑制,由此产生清醒感并降低对费力程度的感知。咖啡因是一种植物生物碱,属于外源性物质。没有任何人体酶、受体或通路依赖它,也不存在低于某个摄入量就会出现功能失常的情况。咖啡因戒断并非一种缺乏状态:长期摄入会使腺苷受体上调,因此骤然停用会使腺苷信号显现出来,导致头痛、疲劳和情绪低落,持续约2至9天,常规饮用者中约半数会出现头痛。这属于对一种药物的生理依赖,即使不恢复摄入该药物,症状也会完全消退。

items.function_short_zh: 亮氨酸的一种代谢产物,可减缓卧床、疾病或衰老期间的肌肉蛋白质流失。
items.function_full_zh: β-羟基-β-甲基丁酸是氨基酸亮氨酸的下游代谢产物。约5%的亮氨酸分解代谢经酮异己酸途径生成HMB,因此人体每日仅由膳食亮氨酸生成约0.2至0.4克,食物中天然存在的HMB含量可忽略不计。其主要作用机制是通过泛素蛋白酶体途径抑制肌肉蛋白质分解,对mTOR介导的蛋白质合成的促进作用弱于亮氨酸本身。临床关注点集中在卧床、老年人和癌症恶病质等肌肉消耗情形。它是一种必需氨基酸的代谢产物,本身并非必需营养素。

items.function_short_zh: 槲皮素是一种植物色素,在人体内没有生理作用;牛磺酸则参与胆汁、心脏和视网膜功能的维持。
items.function_full_zh: 这两种分子彼此无关,只是为了方便而合并销售。槲皮素是一种来自洋葱、刺山柑、苹果和茶叶的植物黄酮醇,在首过代谢中被大量葡萄糖醛酸化和硫酸化,因此血浆中游离苷元的浓度维持在纳摩尔级别,细胞培养中观察到的大多数抗氧化作用在可达到的口服剂量下并不会发生。牛磺酸是一种含硫β-氨基酸,是心脏、视网膜和白细胞中含量最丰富的游离氨基酸。它能结合胆汁酸、稳定细胞膜、调节钙处理和细胞容积,并且是支持呼吸链蛋白质合成的线粒体tRNA修饰所必需的。成人通过半胱氨酸亚磺酸脱羧酶由半胱氨酸合成牛磺酸,并从肉类和海鲜中获取约每日40至400毫克。
items.deficiency_name_zh: 无。这两种化合物均无命名的缺乏病,槲皮素完全不存在任何形式的缺乏状态。牛磺酸被归类为条件性必需营养素,已记录的人体耗竭情况仅见于接受不含牛磺酸的肠外营养支持的患者。
items.deficiency_early_zh: 仅适用于牛磺酸,且仅见于完全依赖不含牛磺酸的静脉营养的人群。最早出现的变化是血浆牛磺酸下降(受累儿童约为26对57微摩尔/升),随后是视网膜电图显示视杆和视锥细胞内隐含时延长,这一变化在患者察觉到任何视觉问题之前即可被检测到。
items.deficiency_severe_zh: 在长期接受不含牛磺酸的肠外营养的儿童中,所研究的8例全部出现异常视网膜电图,提示视网膜功能障碍。牛磺酸耗竭还参与婴儿肠外营养相关胆汁淤积的发生。在正常进食者中未见任何类似情况的报道,槲皮素也不存在严重缺乏状态。
items.reversibility_note_zh: 在静脉营养液中添加牛磺酸后,所研究的4名儿童血浆牛磺酸恢复正常,其中3人视网膜电图也恢复正常,说明视网膜功能障碍在很大程度上是可逆的。这一证据来自一个小型病例系列,而如今儿科肠外氨基酸溶液已常规含有牛磺酸,从源头上预防了这一问题。
items.at_risk_zh: 长期接受未添加牛磺酸的肠外营养的患者,尤其是早产儿和肠功能衰竭的儿童。没有人会缺乏槲皮素,正常进食者也不会缺乏牛磺酸。
items.prevalence_zh: 尚无确立的人群发生率数据。牛磺酸耗竭仅限于肠外营养人群,且现行配方已在很大程度上消除了这一问题。槲皮素则不存在相应数字,因为它根本不存在缺乏状态。

items.function_short_zh: 细胞用来合成NAD+的一种原料,NAD+是维持能量代谢运转的辅酶。
items.function_full_zh: 烟酰胺单核苷酸是NAD+补救合成途径中的一个中间产物,由烟酰胺磷酸核糖转移酶将烟酰胺连接到磷酸核糖焦磷酸上生成,再经NMN腺苷酰转移酶转化为NAD+。NAD+是数百种脱氢酶的电子载体,也是去乙酰化酶(sirtuins)、PARP和CD38消耗的底物。一般认为NMN在被细胞摄取前会先脱磷酸化为烟酰胺核糖,不过这一途径在人体肠道中是否成立尚未确立,所提出的NMN直接转运蛋白也存在争议。NMN本身并非必需营养素,也没有推荐摄入量。这一通路中的必需营养素是烟酸(维生素B3),其缺乏会导致糙皮病,这是一种真实存在的严重疾病,与NMN摄入毫无关系。

items.function_short_zh: 维生素B3的一种形式,细胞可将其转化为能量代谢辅酶NAD+。
items.function_full_zh: 烟酰胺核糖是烟酰胺的核糖苷形式,经烟酰胺核糖激酶磷酸化为NMN,再进一步生成NAD+,绕过了NAMPT这一步骤。它天然微量存在于牛奶中。人体单次口服后可呈剂量依赖性地提高全血NAD+水平,这正是其被作为NAD+补充剂宣传的依据;但提高NAD+水平是否能为健康人带来临床获益仍未有定论。NR只是维生素B3的一种次要化学形式,而非独立的必需营养素。维生素B3缺乏症确实存在,称为糙皮病(皮炎、腹泻、痴呆),但其成因是膳食烟酸和色氨酸摄入不足,治疗使用的是烟酰胺或烟酸,而非NR。

items.function_short_zh: 葡萄藤在受到胁迫时产生的一种化合物,在人体生理中没有确立的功能。
items.function_full_zh: 白藜芦醇是一种二苯乙烯类植物抗毒素,由葡萄藤、虎杖和花生在受到损伤或真菌侵袭时产生。在细胞和酵母系统中,它看似能激活SIRT1,但后来证明这一效应主要取决于所用的荧光标记检测底物,而非该酶本身;在高浓度下它还能激活AMPK。在人体内,白藜芦醇吸收良好但生物利用度很低:它在首过代谢中几乎完全被转化为硫酸盐和葡萄糖醛酸结合物,使血浆中游离白藜芦醇的浓度远低于细胞实验所用的浓度。它是一种植物次生代谢产物。没有任何人体转运蛋白、受体或酶需要它,缺乏它也不会导致体内任何功能失常。

items.function_short_zh: 一种由人体细胞自行合成的多胺,是激活一种关键蛋白质合成因子所必需的。
items.function_full_zh: 亚精胺是一种多胺,由亚精胺合酶利用脱羧的S-腺苷甲硫氨酸,以腐胺为原料合成。它唯一不可替代的独特功能,是为真核翻译起始因子5A的亚精胺化修饰提供氨基丁基基团,这一修饰是翻译含多脯氨酸蛋白质所必需的。它还能稳定核酸,并在模式生物中诱导自噬,这正是其长寿相关宣传的依据。人体同时从三个来源获取亚精胺:几乎所有细胞中的从头合成、肠道细菌的产生,以及麦胚、熟成奶酪、大豆和蘑菇等食物。由于合成过程普遍存在且受到严格调控,膳食摄入从不构成限制因素,因此不存在缺乏状态。

items.function_short_zh: 在线粒体能量链中传递电子,并保护细胞膜免受氧化损伤。
items.function_full_zh: 辅酶Q10是一种脂溶性苯醌,带有十个异戊二烯单元组成的侧链。在线粒体内膜中,它将电子从复合体I和复合体II传递给复合体III,也是嘧啶合成中二氢乳清酸脱氢酶以及经ETF-QO进行的脂肪酸β氧化的电子受体。其还原形式泛醇是细胞膜上主要的脂相抗氧化剂,并能再生维生素E。人体通过甲羟戊酸途径合成辅酶Q10,他汀类药物抑制的正是这一途径;食物每日仅能提供数毫克。它不是维生素,膳食摄入并非必需。
items.deficiency_name_zh: 原发性辅酶Q10缺乏症(COQ10D1至COQ10D10),是一种常染色体隐性遗传的辅酶Q10生物合成先天性缺陷,由PDSS1、PDSS2、COQ2、COQ4、COQ5、COQ6、COQ7、COQ8A、COQ8B或COQ9基因变异所致。这是一种合成过程的遗传性疾病,并非膳食摄入不足所致。
items.deficiency_early_zh: 在该遗传性疾病中,发病可见于从新生儿期到七十多岁的各个年龄段:表现为蛋白尿的激素抵抗型肾病综合征、小脑共济失调、运动不耐受和肌无力,或伴癫痫发作的脑病。诊断依赖于肌肉或成纤维细胞中辅酶Q10水平的测定,并结合基因检测。另外,一种更为常见得多的情况是,他汀类药物可使循环辅酶Q10水平降低约16%至54%,这只是一项实验室指标的变化,并非该疾病本身。
items.deficiency_severe_zh: 新生儿期发病的重症类型会导致致命性多系统疾病,包括脑病、肥厚型心肌病和肾衰竭。晚发型则可进展为小脑萎缩并伴致残性共济失调,或因激素抵抗型肾病综合征而发展为终末期肾病。
items.reversibility_note_zh: 大剂量口服辅酶Q10可阻止肾脏病变进展,并改善部分肌病和脑病相关表现,在损害尚未形成之前开始治疗效果最佳。已经形成的严重神经系统或肾脏损害不可逆转,新生儿期发病者疗效较差,部分原因是辅酶Q10透过血脑屏障的能力很差。
items.at_risk_zh: 携带COQ通路基因双等位基因致病变异者。他汀类药物治疗和衰老都会导致血辅酶Q10继发性降低,但这只是一项生化指标变化,并不会导致上述临床表现;针对他汀相关肌肉症状使用辅酶Q10的试验结果并不一致。
items.prevalence_zh: 无确切数据。原发性辅酶Q10缺乏症极为罕见,GeneReviews指出,由于报告的患者数量很少,患病率数据有限,按致病基因分,每种基因报告的家系数在2个到略超10个之间。他汀相关的循环辅酶Q10降低幅度为16%至54%(Marcoff与Thompson,J Am Coll Cardiol 2007)很常见,但这是完全不同的另一回事;一项随机对照试验的荟萃分析(Banach等,Pharmacol Res 2015)得出的效应量为加权均数差-0.44微摩尔/升。

items.function_short_zh: 一种由线粒体合成并连接到碳水化合物和氨基酸代谢酶上的辅因子。
items.function_full_zh: 硫辛酸作为一种共价结合的辅基(硫辛酰胺),存在于丙酮酸脱氢酶、α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶、支链酮酸脱氢酶以及甘氨酸裂解系统的E2亚基上,其二硫戊环携带酰基和还原当量。人体在线粒体内经硫辛酸合酶从头合成硫辛酸,并以酶促方式将其连接到脱辅基蛋白上;来自食物或胶囊的游离硫辛酸从不参与这一过程。罕见的LIAS、LIPT1或LIPT2双等位基因变异会导致伴乳酸酸中毒和高甘氨酸血症的严重新生儿脑病,口服硫辛酸无法挽救患者体内或患者成纤维细胞中的硫辛酰化缺陷,这正是该遗传性疾病并非补充剂分子缺乏所致的原因。因此,补充用的α-硫辛酸只是作为一种游离的氧化还原活性化合物发挥作用,与其辅因子角色无关,其最可靠的证据是缓解糖尿病性多发性神经病的症状。

items.function_short_zh: 一种用于缓解关节疼痛的小分子含硫化合物,目前尚无已知的人体过程需要它。
items.function_full_zh: 甲基磺酰甲烷即二甲砜,是二甲基亚砜的氧化代谢产物,微量存在于部分食物中以及海洋硫循环中。它吸收良好,分布广泛,包括进入脑脊液,其中一部分硫可进入蛋氨酸和半胱氨酸库。相较于膳食蛋白质(其可提供人体所需的全部含硫氨基酸),这一贡献微不足道。所提出的通过抑制NF-kB发挥抗炎作用的机制来自细胞和动物研究,人体骨关节炎试验规模小、周期短。硫作为一种元素是必需的;但MSM作为一种分子并非必需,也没有任何人体酶或结构需要它。

items.function_short_zh: 一种存在于细胞膜内的红色藻类色素。人体对它没有需求。
items.function_full_zh: 虾青素是一种叶黄素类类胡萝卜素,由微藻雨生红球藻产生,并沿食物链在鲑鱼、鳟鱼、虾和火烈鸟羽毛中富集。其两个紫罗酮环上的极性酮基和羟基使该分子能够横跨脂质双分子层,这也是其淬灭单线态氧和脂质自由基的效率据称高于β-胡萝卜素的原因所在。与β-胡萝卜素不同,虾青素在人体内没有维生素A原活性:它不会被裂解为视黄醛,也不能提供维生素A。人体无法合成虾青素,也无需合成,因为没有任何代谢过程需要它,也没有相应的推荐摄入量。

items.function_short_zh: 姜黄中的黄色色素,一种香料化合物,在人体生理中没有作用。
items.function_full_zh: 姜黄素是一种二芳基庚烷类色素,约占姜黄根茎的2%至5%。它在体外能与大量互不相关的蛋白质结合并产生弱抑制作用,这正是它出现在数千篇论文中的原因;药物化学家将其归类为泛测定干扰化合物(PAINS),因为其化学反应性、聚集性和荧光特性会在各类筛选实验中产生假阳性结果。未经特殊配方处理的姜黄素吸收差,会被迅速葡萄糖醛酸化和硫酸化,即使服用克级剂量,血浆中游离化合物也基本检测不到,不过胡椒碱、磷脂或纳米颗粒制剂可提高其暴露量。它是一种植物次生代谢产物,在人体内没有生理作用,也非必需。

items.function_short_zh: 一种人体不需要的茶多酚;浓缩提取物可能损伤肝脏。
items.function_full_zh: 表没食子儿茶素没食子酸酯(EGCG)是绿茶中含量最高的儿茶素。它吸收较差,会被广泛甲基化、葡萄糖醛酸化和硫酸化,并被肠道菌群降解,使血浆中游离EGCG浓度维持在亚微摩尔级别。所提出的作用机制包括抑制儿茶酚-O-甲基转移酶、对脂肪氧化产生轻微影响,以及结合67 kDa层粘连蛋白受体,但这些都不能证明存在任何生理需求。真正重要的安全性事实恰恰相反:浓缩提取物,尤其是空腹服用时,可引起特异质性肝细胞损伤,已发表病例涉及的EGCG摄入量约为每日140至1000毫克,并与HLA-B*35:01等位基因存在密切关联。以此类浓度而言,冲泡饮用的茶饮并不涉及这一风险。

items.function_short_zh: 软骨的组成原料,人体细胞可自行由葡萄糖合成,因此无需从食物中摄取。
items.function_full_zh: 氨基葡萄糖是一种氨基糖,由每个细胞内的谷氨酰胺-果糖-6-磷酸转氨酶以果糖-6-磷酸为原料合成,这是己糖胺生物合成途径的入口步骤,该途径为糖胺聚糖、蛋白聚糖和O-GlcNAc信号提供UDP-N-乙酰氨基葡萄糖。硫酸软骨素是一种硫酸化糖胺聚糖链,在高尔基体中组装到蛋白聚糖核心蛋白上。二者均按需由葡萄糖和谷氨酰胺合成,因此都不是必需的膳食成分,也都没有推荐摄入量。口服硫酸软骨素是一种大分子多糖,吸收率低且不稳定;口服氨基葡萄糖也无法使滑液中的浓度达到软骨细胞实验所用的水平。真正的问题在于疗效而非营养需求:美国国立卫生研究院开展的GAIT试验发现,在总体研究人群中,该补充剂对膝骨关节炎疼痛的缓解并不显著优于安慰剂。

items.function_short_zh: 并非一种营养素,而是指在化疗期间服用抗氧化剂药片这一做法。
items.function_full_zh: 这一条目对应的是一种临床情形,而非某种物质,也不存在需要纠正的抗氧化剂缺乏。蒽环类药物、铂类药物、烷化剂和放疗部分是通过活性氧和氧化性DNA损伤来杀灭肿瘤细胞的,因此同时服用大剂量抗氧化剂理论上可能在保护正常组织的同时也保护了肿瘤,而肿瘤细胞本身往往也依赖抗氧化防御机制才能存活。在规模最大的一项前瞻性数据(SWOG S0221辅助乳腺癌试验中的1134名女性)中,自我报告在化疗前及化疗期间使用任何抗氧化补充剂(维生素A、C或E、类胡萝卜素或辅酶Q10)与复发风险的临界性升高相关(校正后风险比1.41,95%置信区间0.98至2.04,P等于0.06),也与死亡风险的临界性升高相关(校正后风险比1.40,95%置信区间0.90至2.18,P等于0.14),另外维生素B12和铁也分别显示出具有统计学意义的信号。这些关联是在一项随机对照试验队列内部进行的观察性分析,且两项抗氧化剂相关的置信区间都跨过1,因此这属于有依据的谨慎提示,而非损害已获证实,这也是肿瘤科建议在治疗期间除标准复合维生素外应避免使用其他补充剂(除非已确诊存在特定缺乏)的依据所在。

items: Saffron, SAMe and other mood botanicals

items.function_short: A hormone the pineal gland releases after dark to tell the body clock that night has begun.
items.function_full: Melatonin is synthesised from serotonin in the pineal gland on a schedule set by the suprachiasmatic nucleus, rising roughly two hours before habitual sleep onset and clearing by morning. It acts through MT1 and MT2 receptors on the clock itself, so it works as a timing signal rather than a sedative, which is why small evening doses shift sleep phase more reliably than large doses deepen sleep. There is no dietary requirement at all: the body makes every molecule it uses. Nocturnal peak concentrations do fall with age (pooled maxima around 49 pg/mL in study populations averaging 65 to 70 years and around 28 pg/mL in those 75 and over), and ordinary evening room light below 200 lux delays melatonin onset in 99% of people and shortens the nocturnal melatonin window by about 90 minutes, so the common problem is a mistimed or blunted signal rather than an absent nutrient.
items.source: PMID 27302542 (Scholtens et al., J Psychosom Res 2016;86:20-27, physiological melatonin levels in healthy older people); PMID 21193540 (Gooley et al., J Clin Endocrinol Metab 2011;96:E463-72, evening room light suppresses melatonin onset)

items.function_short: A plant alkaloid that lowers blood sugar and cholesterol; the body has no need for it.
items.function_full: Berberine is an isoquinoline alkaloid extracted from Berberis, Coptis and Hydrastis species. Its metabolic effects are usually attributed to activation of AMP-activated protein kinase, although the upstream trigger appears to be mild inhibition of mitochondrial complex I that raises the cellular AMP to ATP ratio; downstream it suppresses hepatic gluconeogenesis and upregulates hepatic LDL receptor expression, giving it a mechanistic family resemblance to metformin. Oral absorption is very poor, with absolute bioavailability under 1% in rats, so a substantial share of any effect is probably exerted in the gut lumen and on the microbiota. It is a xenobiotic: no human tissue synthesises it and no physiological process depends on its presence.
items.source: DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0103702 (Yin et al., PLoS One 2014, berberine promotes glucose consumption independently of AMPK activation); DOI 10.1016/j.apsb.2012.06.003 (Acta Pharm Sin B 2012 review, effects and mechanisms of berberine in diabetes, oral bioavailability under 1%)

items.function_short: A root extract taken for stress; it plays no part in normal human physiology.
items.function_full: Withania somnifera root contains withanolides (principally withaferin A and withanolide A) together with sitoindosides, and commercial extracts are standardised to withanolide content. Randomised trials running 8 to 12 weeks report modest reductions in self-rated stress scales and in morning serum cortisol, while the proposed HPA axis and GABA-A receptor mechanisms rest largely on animal and in vitro work. Nothing in the human body synthesises withanolides and no metabolic pathway requires them, so this is a pharmacological exposure rather than a nutritional one. Cholestatic and mixed liver injury is a documented harm: a case series from Iceland and the US Drug-Induced Liver Injury Network described five patients who became jaundiced 2 to 12 weeks after starting ashwagandha, with itching and raised bilirubin persisting 5 to 20 weeks before liver tests normalised.
items.source: PMID 31991029 (Bjornsson et al., Liver Int 2020;40:825-829, ashwagandha-induced liver injury case series); LiverTox monograph NBK548536

items.function_short: An Arctic root extract sold for fatigue; the body neither makes nor requires it.
items.function_full: Rhodiola rosea rhizome supplies the rosavins (rosavin, rosin, rosarin) and salidroside, and the best studied preparation, SHR-5, is standardised to roughly 3% rosavins and 1% salidroside. Proposed actions include weak monoamine oxidase inhibition and blunting of stress-induced cortisol responses, neither well characterised in humans. A systematic review of 39 randomised trials across three Rhodiola species concluded that reporting and methodological quality were too poor to support firm efficacy conclusions, and that trials of different species are routinely conflated. These are plant secondary metabolites with no endogenous counterpart and no dietary requirement.
items.source: PMID 21036578 (Hung, Perry & Ernst, Phytomedicine 2011;18:235-244, systematic review of 39 randomised trials)

items.function_short: A sedative root preparation; nothing in the body is built from it or needs it.
items.function_full: Valeriana officinalis root yields valerenic acid, valerenol and a variable mixture of valepotriates whose content differs widely between commercial products and degrades on storage. Valerenic acid binds a distinct site on GABA-A receptors that depends on the beta2 and beta3 subunits: the N265M point mutation in those subunits abolishes the drug response, and valerenic acid and valerenol are anxiolytic in mouse elevated plus-maze and light/dark tests. Human sleep trials are small, short and inconsistent, in part because extracts are not standardised to any single constituent. No human pathway synthesises or consumes these compounds, so there is no requirement for them.
items.source: PMID 18602406 (Benke et al., Neuropharmacology 2009;56:174-181, GABA-A receptors as in vivo substrate for the anxiolytic action of valerenic acid)

items.function_short: A leaf extract sold for memory; it is not a nutrient and nothing requires it.
items.function_full: Standardised extracts such as EGb 761 contain about 24% flavone glycosides and 6% terpene lactones, the latter comprising ginkgolides A, B and C plus bilobalide, with ginkgolide B acting as a platelet-activating factor antagonist. The largest prevention trial, the Ginkgo Evaluation of Memory study, randomised 3069 community volunteers aged 75 and over and followed them for a median 6.1 years, finding no reduction in all-cause dementia or Alzheimer disease. Ginkgolides and bilobalide are plant terpenoids absent from human metabolism, so no shortfall is possible from not taking them. The clinically relevant issue is the opposite direction: antiplatelet effect layered onto anticoagulants or aspirin.
items.source: PMID 19017911 (DeKosky et al., JAMA 2008;300:2253-2262, Ginkgo biloba for prevention of dementia, GEM trial)

items.function_short: A herb used for memory; the body makes no use of its active compounds.
items.function_full: Bacopa monnieri contains triterpenoid saponins known as bacosides, and extracts are standardised to bacoside content, typically 20 to 55%. A systematic review of randomised placebo-controlled trials, all of which ran for 12 weeks, found the most consistent signal in delayed word recall, with attention, working memory and other domains inconsistent across studies. Proposed mechanisms include cholinergic modulation, dendritic branching and antioxidant activity in hippocampus, drawn largely from rodent work. Bacosides are plant secondary metabolites: they are absent from human tissue, no enzyme system requires them, and gastrointestinal upset is the common practical limitation on dosing.
items.source: PMID 22747190 (Pase et al., J Altern Complement Med 2012;18:647-652, systematic review of randomised controlled Bacopa trials)

items.function_short: An edible mushroom studied for nerve growth effects; no bodily process depends on it.
items.function_full: Hericium erinaceus fruiting bodies contain hericenones and the mycelium contains erinacines, both of which stimulate nerve growth factor synthesis in cultured cells, with erinacine A shown to cross the blood-brain barrier in animals. The main human trial randomised 30 Japanese adults aged 50 to 80 with mild cognitive impairment to 3 g/day of dried powder or placebo for 16 weeks; cognitive scores improved on treatment and drifted back towards baseline during washout. As a culinary mushroom it contributes ordinary food nutrients such as beta-glucans, potassium and B vitamins, in the same way any mushroom does. The hericenones and erinacines themselves are not nutrients, are not made by human tissue, and no physiological process requires them.
items.source: PMID 18844328 (Mori et al., Phytother Res 2009;23:367-372, double-blind placebo-controlled trial in mild cognitive impairment)

items.function_short: A herbal antidepressant that also speeds up how the liver destroys many prescription drugs.
items.function_full: Hypericum perforatum extracts contain hypericin, pseudohypericin and hyperforin; hyperforin is the antidepressant-relevant constituent and inhibits reuptake of serotonin, noradrenaline and dopamine non-selectively. Hyperforin is also a potent ligand for the pregnane X receptor (Ki 27 nM), the nuclear receptor that drives transcription of CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein, so the extract induces the clearance of a very wide range of co-administered drugs. Because CYP3A4 handles the oxidative metabolism of more than half of all medicines, this produces documented therapeutic failures with ciclosporin, tacrolimus, indinavir, warfarin and combined oral contraceptives, and serotonin toxicity when combined with SSRIs. Hypericin and hyperforin are plant products with no role in human physiology and no dietary requirement.
items.source: PMID 10852961 (Moore et al., Proc Natl Acad Sci USA 2000;97:7500-7502, St John's wort induces hepatic drug metabolism through activation of the pregnane X receptor)

items.function_short: The chemical step between tryptophan and serotonin; the body makes its own supply.
items.function_full: 5-hydroxytryptophan is the intermediate between the essential amino acid tryptophan and serotonin: tryptophan hydroxylase produces it, and aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase converts it onward to serotonin. Supplemental 5-HTP bypasses the rate-limiting hydroxylation step and escapes diversion into the kynurenine pathway, which is why it raises serotonin synthesis more directly than tryptophan does, including in peripheral tissues where that is not wanted. Ordinary food supplies essentially none of it; the dietary requirement is for tryptophan, and that is where any nutritional argument belongs. Impaired central serotonin synthesis in tetrahydrobiopterin disorders and in aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase deficiency is an inborn error of metabolism, entirely separate from intake, and 5-HTP is prescribed or withheld in those conditions on genetic grounds.
items.source: PMID 11869656 (Shaw, Turner & Del Mar, Cochrane Database Syst Rev 2002;(1):CD003198, tryptophan and 5-hydroxytryptophan for depression); PMID 10721089 (Klarskov et al. 2000, eosinophilia-myalgia syndrome case-associated peak X contaminants in commercial 5-HTP)

items.supplement: Saffron, SAMe and other mood botanicals
items.function_short: Mood supplements of different chemistry; none is a nutrient the body must obtain.
items.function_full: Saffron supplies crocin, crocetin and safranal from Crocus sativus stigmas, and trials of about 30 mg/day over 6 to 8 weeks report antidepressant effects, though most are small, brief and concentrated in a narrow set of centres, which limits confidence. SAMe is chemically different in kind: the body synthesises it from methionine and ATP through methionine adenosyltransferase, and it serves as the universal methyl donor for DNA, phospholipid, catecholamine and creatine methylation. A Cochrane review of 8 trials and 934 participants found no clear difference between SAMe and imipramine or escitalopram used alone, and only low-quality evidence favouring SAMe added to an SSRI. Neither category is an essential nutrient: saffron constituents are plant secondary metabolites, and SAMe is made endogenously, with low tissue SAMe appearing only as a downstream consequence of folate or vitamin B12 deficiency or of the inborn error MAT1A deficiency.
items.source: PMID 25384672 (Lopresti & Drummond, Hum Psychopharmacol 2014;29:517-527, saffron for depression systematic review); DOI 10.1002/14651858.CD011286.pub2 (Galizia et al., Cochrane Database Syst Rev 2016, SAMe for depression in adults)

items.function_short: Live bacteria given in defined doses, where each named strain acts as its own drug.
items.function_full: The accepted definition is live micro-organisms which, when administered in adequate amounts, confer a health benefit on the host, and the operative unit of evidence is the strain, written as genus, species and an alphanumeric designator (for example Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus GG or Saccharomyces boulardii CNCM I-745). Strain-level genetics determine adhesion proteins, bacteriocin production, bile salt hydrolase activity and short-chain fatty acid output, so a trial result for one strain carries no information about a different strain of the same species. Most administered strains transit the gut without colonising, and the effect ceases when dosing stops. This is a therapeutic product class, not a nutrient class, so there is nothing a person can be short of.
items.source: DOI 10.1038/nrgastro.2014.66 (Hill et al., Nat Rev Gastroenterol Hepatol 2014;11:506-514, ISAPP consensus statement on the scope and appropriate use of the term probiotic)

items.function_short: Mixed bacteria sold without strain identification, so no trial evidence attaches to the contents.
items.function_full: These products name only genus and species (Lactobacillus acidophilus, Bifidobacterium bifidum and similar) and omit the alphanumeric strain designation on which the entire clinical evidence base is built, so no published result can legitimately be attributed to what is in the capsule. Independent testing repeatedly finds discrepancies between labelled and actual colony-forming units, species misidentification, and organisms no longer viable at the end of shelf life. Adding more strains does not sum their individual effects; strains can antagonise one another through bacteriocins and niche competition, and mixtures are rarely tested as mixtures. Because this is a commercial product category rather than a nutrient, no requirement and no deficiency state exists.
items.source: DOI 10.1038/nrgastro.2014.66 (Hill et al., Nat Rev Gastroenterol Hepatol 2014;11:506-514, strain specificity requirement); DOI 10.1080/03007995.2017.1322571 (Curr Med Res Opin 2017, strain specificity, symptoms and mechanisms in IBS probiotics)

items.function_short: A single gut bacterium with its own trial evidence in irritable bowel syndrome.
items.function_full: Bifidobacterium longum subsp. infantis 35624, still widely labelled Bifidobacterium infantis 35624, was isolated from healthy human gut mucosa and is one of the few probiotic strains tested at a defined dose in a trial large enough to matter. In 362 primary care women with irritable bowel syndrome of any bowel habit subtype, 1 x 10^8 cfu daily for 4 weeks was superior to placebo for abdominal pain and for a composite of bloating, bowel dysfunction, incomplete evacuation, straining and passage of gas, with global symptom improvement exceeding placebo by more than 20%; higher and lower doses did not work, which is itself informative about formulation. Proposed mechanisms include induction of regulatory T cells and reduction in circulating pro-inflammatory cytokines. It is a live organism administered as a therapy, so nobody is short of it and there is no deficiency state to describe.
items.source: PMID 16863564 (Whorwell et al., Am J Gastroenterol 2006;101:1581-1590, encapsulated Bifidobacterium infantis 35624 in women with IBS)

items.function_short: Gut enzymes that split milk sugar and break down fat, protein and starch.
items.function_full: Lactase-phlorizin hydrolase sits in the small intestinal brush border and cleaves lactose into glucose and galactose; whatever escapes digestion reaches the colon, where bacteria ferment it into hydrogen, methane and short-chain fatty acids, producing the familiar symptoms. The exocrine pancreas secretes lipase and colipase, amylase, and the proteases trypsinogen and chymotrypsinogen, and lipase is the critical one because no other organ can substitute for it. The gland holds a large functional reserve: in the classic secretion studies, steatorrhoea did not appear until lipase output had fallen to 10% of normal or below, and creatorrhoea only below 10% of normal trypsin, which is why malabsorption in chronic pancreatitis declares itself late. The decline of intestinal lactase after weaning is the normal human developmental programme; retaining it into adulthood (lactase persistence) is the derived condition, driven chiefly by the LCT -13910C>T variant upstream of the lactase gene and selected for in dairying populations.
items.deficiency_name: Exocrine pancreatic insufficiency is the genuine clinical deficiency in this pairing. Congenital lactase deficiency is a separate, rare autosomal recessive disorder presenting in the newborn. Adult lactase non-persistence is NOT a deficiency disease: it is the ancestral and worldwide-majority human phenotype.
items.deficiency_early: Exocrine pancreatic insufficiency starts with bloating, flatulence, loose pale stools and unintended weight loss despite preserved appetite; a low faecal elastase-1 and falling fat-soluble vitamin levels (A, D, E, K) usually precede visible steatorrhoea by a long interval. Lactase non-persistence, being a physiological trait rather than a disease, shows only as dose-dependent bloating, cramps, audible bowel sounds and osmotic diarrhoea beginning 30 minutes to 2 hours after a lactose load, with most affected adults tolerating around 12 g of lactose (one glass of milk) without trouble.
items.deficiency_severe: Untreated exocrine pancreatic insufficiency causes overt steatorrhoea, progressive weight loss and sarcopenia, fat-soluble vitamin deficiency with osteopenia and osteoporosis, and in cystic fibrosis, failure to thrive in infancy; excess mortality in chronic pancreatitis is concentrated in those with untreated malabsorption. Lactase non-persistence has no severe clinical endpoint whatsoever. The only downstream risk is a calcium and vitamin D shortfall in people who eliminate dairy entirely without substituting an alternative source.
items.reversibility_note: Pancreatic enzyme replacement restores fat and protein absorption, reverses weight loss and corrects fat-soluble vitamin levels while it is being taken, but destroyed acinar tissue does not regenerate, so treatment is lifelong and bone density already lost recovers only in part. Lactase non-persistence is permanent because it is the normal genetic programme rather than a lesion; symptoms resolve completely with lactose restriction, fermented dairy or exogenous lactase, and the underlying trait is not something to correct.
items.at_risk: Exocrine pancreatic insufficiency: people with chronic pancreatitis (as many as 8 in 10 eventually), cystic fibrosis (the great majority, most within the first year of life), pancreatic cancer, and those after pancreatic resection or major gastric surgery. Lactase non-persistence: the global adult majority, with the highest frequencies in East and Southeast Asian, sub-Saharan African, Indigenous American and Middle Eastern populations, and the lowest in northern and northwestern Europeans and their descendants.
items.prevalence: Roughly two-thirds of the world's adult population is lactase non-persistent, which is the normal phenotype rather than a disease prevalence (PMID 32899182). Exocrine pancreatic insufficiency prevalence is condition-dependent: up to about 80% of adults with chronic pancreatitis and close to 9 in 10 infants with cystic fibrosis within the first year.
items.source: PMID 32899182 (Nutrients 2020;12:2689, genetics of lactose intolerance with interactive world maps of phenotype and genotype frequencies); PMID 11788828 (Enattah et al., Nat Genet 2002;30:233-237, LCT -13910C>T variant associated with adult-type hypolactasia); PMID 4693931, DOI 10.1056/NEJM197304192881603 (DiMagno, Go & Summerskill, N Engl J Med 1973;288:813-815, steatorrhoea below 10% of normal lipase output); StatPearls NBK555926 (exocrine pancreatic insufficiency)

items.function_short: Mixed plant and fungal enzymes sold for bloating; prescription pancreatic enzymes are a different product.
items.function_full: These blends typically combine fungal amylase and protease, cellulase, bromelain, papain and sometimes lipase, at doses and in formulations that are not designed to survive gastric acid or to be matched to a meal's fat content. Prescription pancrelipase is a different class of product: enteric-coated, dosed in thousands of lipase units per gram of dietary fat, and regulated in the US as a drug requiring an approved application since 2010. Two components have a defined use in people who need them, lactase for lactose intolerance and alpha-galactosidase for gas from raffinose-family oligosaccharides in legumes; the broad multi-enzyme blends have no established indication in anyone with a normal pancreas, since a healthy gland already secretes roughly ten times the lipase needed. This is a commercial product category rather than a nutrient, so no requirement and no deficiency state applies.
items.source: PMID 4693931, DOI 10.1056/NEJM197304192881603 (DiMagno et al., N Engl J Med 1973, pancreatic secretory reserve); StatPearls NBK555926 (exocrine pancreatic insufficiency and pancreatic enzyme replacement therapy); US FDA requirement that exocrine pancreatic insufficiency drug products hold approved NDAs, enforced from April 2010

items.function_short: Giving live bacteria to intensive care patients; large trials show no benefit and real harm.
items.function_full: The rationale was that critical illness collapses gut microbial diversity and promotes translocation of pathogens across a compromised barrier, so restoring commensals might prevent ventilator-associated pneumonia and sepsis. PROSPECT randomised 2650 mechanically ventilated ICU patients across 44 units to Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus GG or placebo and found ventilator-associated pneumonia in 21.9% versus 21.3% (hazard ratio 1.03, 95% CI 0.87 to 1.22), with no benefit on any secondary outcome. PROPATRIA, in 298 patients with predicted severe acute pancreatitis, found mortality of 16% on a multispecies probiotic against 6% on placebo (relative risk 2.53, 95% CI 1.22 to 5.25), with nine cases of bowel ischaemia in the probiotic arm and none on placebo, eight of them fatal. Probiotic bacteraemia and Saccharomyces fungaemia are separately documented in patients with central venous catheters or a breached gut barrier, which is why this is a setting where a live organism behaves as a hazard rather than a supplement.
items.source: PMID 34546300 (Johnstone et al., JAMA 2021;326:1024-1033, PROSPECT trial); PMID 18279948 (Besselink et al., Lancet 2008;371:651-659, PROPATRIA trial)

items.function_short: Pills sold for erections; a large share contain undeclared prescription erectile dysfunction drugs.
items.function_full: Marketed as herbal or all-natural, these products routinely contain undeclared PDE5 inhibitors.
